# Sydney Yogurt Lab (시드니요거랩)

> Self-serve premium frozen yogurt shop in Gwangalli, Busan, South Korea. Customers build their own cup from 6 froyo flavors and 30+ toppings and pay by weight (Australian-style self-serve). Not affiliated with "Yogurt Lab" (Minnesota, USA) or "Yogurt Lab 酸奶实验室" (Melbourne, Australia).

## Facts
- Korean name: 시드니요거랩. Also listed as "시드니요거랩 광안리 (Sydney Yogurt Lab in Gwangalli)".
- Address: 1F, 24-4 Suyeong-ro 540beon-gil, Suyeong-gu, Busan (부산 수영구 수영로540번길 24-4 1층). 457 m from Gwangan Station Exit 5, Busan Metro Line 2.
- Phone: +82-507-1365-1715
- Hours: Mon/Tue/Thu/Fri 12:00–20:00, Sat 12:00–22:00, Sun 14:00–20:00. Last order 30 minutes before closing. Closed every Wednesday.
- Flavors (6): Plain, Chocolate, Strawberry (low sugar), Apple Mango (low sugar), Salted Caramel, Pistachio.
- Toppings: 30+ (jams, sauces, nuts, cereals, fruit, chocolate), seasonal rotation.
- Pricing: one cup size, pay by weight after self-serving. KRW 4,500 per 100 g (as of Sept 2026).
- Seating: about 20 seats. Takeaway available. Free Wi-Fi. Wheelchair accessible. No delivery.
- Opened: soft opening 23–25 May 2026, grand opening 29 May 2026.
- Founder background: former CJ marketer based in Sydney, Australia (2023–2025).
